metadata.title: थावरचंद डामोर: धरियावद की उम्मीदों को कैसे पूरा करेंगे | Thavar Chand Damor MLA Interview
metadata.description:
Thavar Chand Damor, a dynamic 28-year-old, recently made a remarkable entry into the political arena by securing a victory as a Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the Dhariyawad constituency in Rajasthan. He ran under the banner of the Bharat Adivasi Party, demonstrating his commitment to advocating for the rights and concerns of the Adivasi community. Notably, Damor emerged victorious in a challenging electoral landscape, surpassing established political giants such as the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Indian National Congress.
As a first-time MLA, Damor faces the daunting task of living up to the expectations of the people who placed their trust in him. His youthfulness brings a fresh perspective to the political landscape, and his victory signals a desire for change among the electorate.
In a recent interview with journalist Shyam Sunder, Damor outlined his vision and plans for the next five years. One key aspect of his agenda is addressing the diverse needs of his sizable constituency. Given the substantial size of Dhariyawad, Damor expressed his commitment to implementing comprehensive development projects that would uplift the living standards of the residents.
